plan.title: Your plan
plan.description: Budget, goals, debts and a what-if simulator, all from your own numbers.

fiftyThirtyTwenty.description: Half for needs, 30% for wants, 20% for savings. Fixed costs and minimum debt payments come out of needs first.

zeroBased.name: Zero-based
zeroBased.description: Every unit of income gets a job. Categories are funded up to their recent average and the rest goes to savings.

custom.name: Custom
custom.description: Start from your recent spending and set each category yourself.

budget.title: Budget for {{month}}
budget.confirmRegenerate: Switching method rebuilds the plan and replaces your unsaved edits. Continue?
budget.tableCaption: Budget lines with this month's actual spending
budget.balanced: Every unit of income has a job.

goals.contribution: Monthly savings for goals: {{amount}}, from the Savings line of your budget.
goals.emptyBody: Add something you are saving for and see when you can reach it.
goals.chartDescription: Projected savings for each goal at your current pace

debts.emptyBody: If you have cards or loans, add them to compare payoff plans.
debts.extraHint: On top of your minimum payments of {{amount}}.
debts.saving: Paying in avalanche order saves {{amount}} in interest compared with snowball.
debts.infeasible: These payments never clear the balance. Increase the extra payment.
debts.chartDescription: Total owed month by month for each strategy

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.description: Highest interest rate first. Costs the least.

snowball.name: Snowball
snowball.description: Smallest balance first. Quick wins keep you going.

simulator.controlsHint: Nothing here is saved. It shows what would happen.
simulator.saveMoreHint: Taken from your flexible spending and sent to your goals.
simulator.shortfall: Your flexible spending cannot cover {{amount}} of that. Only the rest is moved to goals.
simulator.drawdown: In this scenario you spend {{amount}} more than you earn each month, so savings shrink.
simulator.goalsDescription: With {{amount}} a month going to goals
simulator.chartDescription: Cash and savings, not counting the emergency fund
